summary: The code is syntactically valid and runs a minimal agent-based mask adoption simulation with policy and supply elements, but it does not implement many required entities/interactions/metrics from the specification. Additionally, there is a critical performance issue in the small-world rewiring logic that will scale poorly for the target population size. Error handling and CLI are generally solid, and the required direct main() call is present.

issues.description: Missing key entities and interactions specified in the task (Household, WorkplaceSchool, PublicPlace, Retailer, MediaChannel, PolicyMaker as specified; mask market with price elasticity; location-based access control; disease transmission optional). The current simulation uses simplified substitutes (Location, PolicyAuthority, SupplyChain, MediaOutlet) and omits several behaviors and metrics.
issues.location: Overall design (classes and interactions across the codebase)
issues.solution: Implement the specified entities with their attributes/behaviors and wire their interactions: peer_social_influence over explicit social networks, policy compliance/enforcement at workplaces/public places, information diffusion via MediaChannel, mask_market_transaction with supply, prices, and price elasticity, location-based access control, household norms spillover, and optional disease_transmission with mask efficacy. Add corresponding metrics (e.g., workplace_adoption_rate, average_mask_quality_in_use, Rt, infections_averted) and use the provided parameter names.

issues.description: Small-world rewiring builds a full candidate set via set(range(N)) minus neighbors for each edge considered, yielding O(N) work and large allocations per neighbor and leading to O(N^2) behavior for N=10,000.
issues.location: SocialSimulation.initialize -> rewiring loop: candidates = list(set(range(N)) - {i} - set(self.people[i].neighbors))
issues.solution: Avoid constructing set(range(N)) repeatedly. Sample new neighbors by rejection sampling: randomly draw a node j in [0, N-1] until j != i and j not in neighbors, with a bounded number of attempts; or precompute a global list of nodes and use random selection with a constant-time membership check on a set of neighbors. Alternatively, implement standard Watts–Strogatz rewiring by choosing a random node without rebuilding full sets.

issues.description: Parameter names and usage diverge from the specification, so user-provided parameters will not be applied. Examples: mask_price_surgical vs mask_cost_surgical, restock_rate_per_day vs restock_rate_daily, retailer_initial_inventory_per_capita not used, price_elasticity_of_demand unused.
issues.solution: Align parameter keys with the specification. Use mask_price_* keys, restock_rate_per_day, retailer_initial_inventory_per_capita to initialize supply per capita, and apply price_elasticity_of_demand to individual purchase decisions. Consider mapping/aliasing both sets of keys for backward compatibility.

issues.description: Evaluation metrics required by the specification are incomplete. Infections averted and Rt are stubbed; workplace adoption and average_mask_quality_in_use are missing; mandate_compliance_rate is provided but others are not exposed in a dedicated evaluation output.
issues.solution: Implement disease transmission optional (or clearly disable with a config flag) and compute infections_averted relative to a no-mask baseline, and Rt over time. Add workplace_adoption_rate over time, and compute average_mask_quality_in_use weighted by interactions.

issues.description: Network becomes directed after rewiring (edges are not symmetrically updated), which may not be intended for peer influence averaging and can bias results.
issues.solution: Maintain undirected edges by updating both endpoints’ neighbor lists when rewiring, or represent the graph as an undirected structure (e.g., adjacency sets) and ensure symmetry is preserved.

issues.description: Mask attitude is updated but not directly used in the mask-wearing decision utility, reducing coherence between beliefs and behavior.
issues.solution: Include mask_attitude (and perhaps compliance_propensity/trust) explicitly in the latent utility (e.g., add a term proportional to mask_attitude).

issues.description: Location mask_requirement property is never used to gate access or affect penalties; access control specified in the task is not represented.
issues.solution: Implement location-based access control: if mask_requirement is true and agent refuses to wear, deny entry or apply penalties, and reflect this in interactions/contacts.

issues.description: Results CSV is written unconditionally to results.csv every run, which may be undesirable for large runs or parallel executions.
issues.solution: Make CSV output optional and/or configurable via CLI, or include the seed/timestamp in the filename to avoid collisions.

main_call_verification: Confirmed: main() is called directly at the global scope as required.
